## OperationDescriptor interface

Everything a client or runtime needs to know about one operation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface OperationDescriptor<Input, Output>
```

## Remarks

`permission` must equal the permission the manifest derives for the command. The runtime checks this when an app is registered and refuses a mismatch, so a stale or altered package cannot widen authority.
